title: Practice notice: river footbridge closure
body: This is a fictional practice notice. The River Ward footbridge will remain closed from 08:00 on 18 July 2030 until 18:00 on 19 July 2030 because of a high-water drill. Pedestrians should use the marked Market Road crossing. Do not enter the closed footbridge area. A staffed help desk will operate at the Sample Community Hall from 09:00 to 17:00 on both days. If conditions change, the Sample River Ward Emergency Desk will issue a new notice.
